01 / OUR FIRM

A focused litigation practice, built on personal attention and considered advice.

Messrs Shankar Govinth is a sole proprietorship specialising in civil, commercial, and criminal litigation, founded by Shankar Govinth Balachandran. Additional services of corporate drafting and advisory are offered.

Established on 1 February 2021 in Kuala Lumpur, we bring a practical, personal approach to every matter.

03 / OUR PEOPLE

Personal attention.
Professional dedication.

Meet the advocates and solicitors
behind Messrs Shankar Govinth.

FOUNDER

Shankar Govinth

ADVOCATE & SOLICITOR

Founder of Messrs Shankar Govinth, with experience in civil, commercial and criminal litigation, and arbitration.

Read full profile

The firm of Messrs Shankar Govinth was established on the 1st of February 2021. Mr Shankar obtained his Law Degree with Honours from Aberystwyth University, Wales in 2010 and in 2013 completed his Certificate of Legal Practice. He commenced his pupillage at Zul Rafique & Partners and was called to the Malaysian Bar on 7.11.2014. He commenced practice thereafter.

Throughout his years of practice, he has assisted senior counsels on various trials and appeals at the appellate courts as well as arbitration proceedings. Mr Shankar has been exposed to a wide range of civil litigation, and in particular commercial and contractual disputes. Further, he has had conduct of criminal proceedings involving white collar offences and has conducted his own trials and hearings during his years of practice.

Mr Shankar is fluent in both the English and Malay language and is conversant in Mandarin and Tamil. He enjoys sports and travel and is an avid fan of Liverpool FC.

OUR TEAM

Diana Razak

ADVOCATE & SOLICITOR

A dedicated lawyer with a passion for litigation and advocacy, who joined Messrs Shankar Govinth in October 2025.

Read full profile

Diana Razak graduated from Universiti Teknologi MARA with a Bachelor-of-Laws Honors degree in 2022. She commenced pupillage at Messrs Lo Chambers under the tutelage of Mr Irwin Lo where then she was retained as a Legal Associate. In October 2025, she joined Messrs Shankar Govinth.

Diana is a lawyer with genuine passion for litigation where she enjoys navigating complex litigation. Appearing in the court room excites her to improve her advocacy everyday as she strives to be an excellent litigator.

Besides being a dedicated Legal Assistant, Diana enjoys listening to music and go to concerts in her free time.
